verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports natural-language querying (search) and exposes an MCP server so agents can decide via natural language when to save/retrieve memories, plus a CLI and API for terminal-driven operations. However, core operations like add/update/delete still rely on structured API/CLI calls rather than a full natural-language command interface for all actions. Missing for 10: no evidence of a conversational/NL interface covering all CRUD operations, and no independent hands-on confirmation of agents autonomously issuing natural-language commands in practice.
